lines.en: label undeservedfuture14:
I open up the door to Ami’s room and, lo and behold, she’s not inside. Though, I probably could have predicted that on account of it being far too convenient.
lines.zh: 我打开 Ami 的房门，你瞧，她不在里面。不过我大概早该料到，因为那太顺理成章了。

lines.en: We’ve yet to check my house though, so I do my best to be helpful and suggest it to Himawari once she gets off the phone with who I presume is that Shiori girl.
lines.zh: 不过我们还没查过我家，所以等 Himawari 跟那个我想是 Shiori 的女孩打完电话，我尽力帮忙提议去那儿看看。

lines.en: But when she agrees straightaway, I’m suddenly stricken with an odd bout of nervousness at the thought of introducing her to my {i}other{/i} home. The one without her.
lines.zh: 可她一口答应下来时，一想到要把她介绍给我{i}另一个{/i}家——那个没有她的家——我突然涌上一阵莫名的紧张。

lines.en: And I shouldn’t be given that she’s seen it a million times before (albeit via divine spycam), but it doesn’t change anything.
lines.zh: 我不该这样，毕竟她已经看过一百万次了（虽然是通过神圣的偷拍摄像头），可这改变不了什么。

lines.en: I just don’t want her comparing what I have now to what I {i}might{/i} have one day if I play my cards right.
lines.zh: 我只是不想让她拿我现在拥有的，去对比如果我把牌打对了、将来某天{i}可能{/i}会拥有的。

lines.en: Not because I think she’ll be jealous, though. Or that she’ll wish she could be the one there with me, which I know she’ll do regardless.
lines.zh: 不是因为我觉得她会嫉妒。也不是因为她会希望陪在我身边的是她——我知道不管怎样她都会这么想。

lines.en: But because I think it might make her sad. Or lonely when she thinks back on it when this all blows over.
lines.zh: 而是因为我觉得那可能会让她难过。或者等这一切过去之后回想起来，会觉得孤独。

lines.en: I know I will — and she must take after me in some way. So all I can really do is hope that those moments in which she is most {i}purely{/i} my daughter don’t come when the cameras are off.
lines.zh: 我知道我会——而她总归有像我的地方。所以我真正能做的，只有祈祷她最{i}纯粹{/i}地作为我女儿的那些时刻，不要都发生在镜头关掉的时候。

lines.en: But then again, I hope for her sake that they’re never {i}on{/i} at all.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，为了她，我倒希望那些镜头从来就没{i}开着{/i}过。

lines.en: scene clearnightsky
We check the house and find nothing.
lines.zh: 我们查了房子，一无所获。

lines.en: We check the school and find nothing.
lines.zh: 我们查了学校，一无所获。

lines.en: We check the maid cafe and the market in our neighborhood and even the newly renovated mall and {i}still{/i} we find nothing.
lines.zh: 我们查了女仆咖啡馆、我们那条街的超市，甚至新装修的商场，{i}依旧{/i}一无所获。

lines.en: Just how far could she have gone? And {i}how{/i} did she go at all?
lines.zh: 她到底能跑多远？她又是{i}怎么{/i}跑的？

lines.en: Because I might not see Ami the same exact way I see Himawari, but that doesn’t mean the idea of her facing something as terrifying as this alone doesn’t break my heart.
lines.zh: 因为我看待 Ami 的方式也许和看待 Himawari 不完全一样，但那不意味着想到她要独自面对这种可怕的事情，我的心不会碎。

lines.en: And if she’s been doing that all along?...Facing these catastrophes on her own while {i}I{/i} fraternize in tents with her best friend?...
lines.zh: 而如果她一直是这样过来的呢？……在{i}我{/i}跟她最好的朋友在帐篷里厮混的时候，她一个人面对这些灾祸？……

lines.en: If she’s been doing that, what can I even say to her?
lines.zh: 如果她一直是这样过来的，我还能对她说什么？

lines.en: scene himaayanebeach1
: I take it this is what you meant when you said Ami can be “troublesome” sometimes?
lines.zh: : 我猜这就是你说的 Ami 有时候会很「麻烦」的意思？

lines.en: : Not exactly...but you’re not entirely {i}wrong{/i} either. She just makes damn sure that this is always as difficult as possible for us.
lines.zh: : 不完全是……但你也不算全{i}错{/i}。她只是拼了命地确保这件事对我们来说永远尽可能地困难。

lines.en: : So, in the event that we {i}can’t{/i} find her, what happens then?
lines.zh: : 那么，万一我们{i}找不到{/i}她，会发生什么？

lines.en: : The same thing that’s been happening to you and Mom and now Makoto, I guess. She’ll keep all of her memories intact and move onto the next cycle without any reformatting.
lines.zh: : 大概就是一直发生在你、妈妈、现在还有 Makoto 身上的那件事吧。她会保留全部记忆，直接进入下一个循环，不被重新格式化。

lines.en: : Oh...Well, isn’t that a good thing? Wouldn’t we {i}want{/i} her to do that since it’d give us more of a foothold in trying to escape these loops once and for all?
lines.zh: : 哦……那不是好事吗？我们不是正{i}希望{/i}她这样吗，因为那会让我们在彻底逃出这些循环时有更多立足点？

lines.en: : It’s bad for a number of reasons. But before I bother elaborating, do you even think that Ami would {i}want{/i} to leave a place like this?
lines.zh: : 不好，原因有很多。不过在我费劲解释之前，你觉得 Ami 会{i}想{/i}离开这样一个地方吗？

lines.en: scene himaayanebeach2
: Because this is sort of like {i}her{/i} Aomori, isn’t it? A world where she can spend every waking moment with the person she loves the most?
lines.zh: : 因为这有点像{i}她的{/i} Aomori，不是吗？一个她可以醒着的每一刻都跟她最爱的人待在一起的世界。

lines.en: : Maybe...
lines.zh: : 也许吧……

lines.en: : But if this is Maya’s wish, it means that Ami likely already {i}has{/i} some place like that.
lines.zh: : 但如果这是 Maya 的愿望，那就意味着 Ami 大概已经{i}拥有{/i}过那样一个地方了。

lines.en: : And that there’s another her and another me there right now, happily coexisting without the fear and pain and everything else we’ve grown used to here.
lines.zh: : 而此刻那儿还有另一个她、另一个我，幸福地共存着，没有我们在这儿已经习惯的恐惧和痛苦，以及其它一切。

lines.en: : So even if she doesn’t want to leave this place, it wouldn’t be right to just...keel over and let whatever is going to happen {i}actually{/i} happen.
lines.zh: : 所以就算她不想离开这儿，就这么……倒地认命、任由该发生的事{i}发生{/i}，也是不对的。

lines.en: : Especially not if it’s going to put my life with you at risk.
lines.zh: : 尤其如果那会危及我和你在一起的生活。

lines.en: scene himaayanebeach3
: ...What? Why are you looking at me like that?
lines.zh: : ……什么？你为什么这么看着我？

lines.en: : I’m just proud to hear you finally talking like you understand your purpose.
lines.zh: : 我只是很骄傲，终于听到你说出像是明白了自己使命的话。

lines.en: : It’s been tough, you know...Watching you say so many terrible things about yourself from behind a screen. {i}Wanting{/i} to help but knowing I can’t.
lines.zh: : 这一路挺难的，你知道……隔着屏幕听你说那么多贬低自己的话。{i}想{/i}帮忙，却知道我办不到。

lines.en: scene himaayanebeach4
: If I wasn’t so brave and strong, this might even be the scene where I jump into your arms and start crying about not wanting to leave again.
lines.zh: : 如果我没有这么勇敢、这么坚强，这大概就是我会扑进你怀里、哭着说不想再离开的那一幕了。

lines.en: : Do you {i}ever{/i} cry? Because I can’t really imagine it. Or do you just take after your mother and do it in private?
lines.zh: : 你哭{i}过{/i}吗？因为我实在想象不出来。还是说你随你妈妈，只在私下里哭？

lines.en: : That’s for me to know and you to never find out. But I’ll tell you this — if I {i}was{/i} going to cry, I definitely wouldn’t do it while you’re still here.
lines.zh: : 这可是我的秘密，你永远别想知道。不过我可以告诉你——如果我{i}要{/i}哭，我绝对不会在你还在这儿的时候哭。

lines.en: : Don’t want your final moments with me to be spoiled by the fact that you’d have to keep handing me tissues. Banter like this is much healthier.
lines.zh: : 我不想让你跟我最后的时光，被不停地给我递纸巾这件事给毁了。像这样斗嘴健康多了。

lines.en: : I don’t mind being your tissue dispenser if I have to. Comes with the territory, probably. I don’t know. I only have a few months of experience when it comes to being an {i}actual{/i} father.
lines.zh: : 如果需要的话，我不介意当你的纸巾盒。大概算是职责所在吧。我也不知道。我当{i}真正的{/i}父亲才几个月经验。

lines.en: scene himaayanebeach5
: It was a great few months, though...wasn’t it?
lines.zh: : 那几个月很棒，不过……不是吗？

lines.en: : It was...
lines.zh: : 是很棒……

lines.en: : Maybe don’t check your phone for a few months {i}after{/i} this, though. I’m probably going to be in even worse shape than Ayane once you’re gone.
lines.zh: : 不过这{i}之后{/i}几个月你最好别看手机。你走了以后，我大概会比 Ayane 还要惨。

lines.en: : You’ll be fine. Don’t worry. I know you’ll figure things out even when I’m not there to guide you.
lines.zh: : 你会没事的。别担心。我知道就算我不在旁边引导你，你也能把事情想明白。

lines.en: : Well, I’m glad {i}you{/i} have faith in me, at least.
lines.zh: : 好吧，至少{i}你{/i}对我有信心，这点我挺高兴。

lines.en: : It’s much easier to have faith when you know how everything ends.
lines.zh: : 当你知道一切会怎么结束的时候，有信心就容易多了。

lines.en: : Yet here you are, breaking every single rule your weird god-company has in order to validate that faith. Why not just let it all play out and trust the process if you’re so sure?
lines.zh: : 可你现在就在这儿，为了兑现那份信心，把你那家奇怪的神之公司的每一条规矩都破了个遍。既然你这么确定，为什么不干脆让它自然发展、相信过程就好？

lines.en: scene himaayanebeach6
: Because, despite my status as the bravest and cutest time-travelling magical girl to ever set foot in Kumon-mi, I’m still just an annoying teenager who loves her parents too much for her own good.
lines.zh: : 因为，尽管我是踏上 Kumon-mi 土地的有史以来最勇敢、最可爱的时间旅行魔法少女，我终究也只是个烦人的、爱爸妈爱到对自己没好处的青春期少女。

lines.en: : That said, you should probably hurry up and escape this terrible fate so I stop making bad decisions. I require guidance you can not provide from this dimension.
lines.zh: : 话虽如此，你大概该赶紧逃离这可怕的命运了，好让我别再做错误的决定。我需要你从这个次元里给不了的指导。

lines.en: : I’ll do what I can...
lines.zh: : 我会尽我所能……

lines.en: scene himaayanebeach5
: I just hope that knowing you’re out there watching over us doesn’t influence my actions {i}too{/i} much. Because there are a {i}lot{/i} of girls who might murder me if I stop giving them attention.
lines.zh: : 我只希望，知道你在外面看着我们这件事，不会{i}太多{/i}地影响我的行动。因为要是我不再给她们关注，有{i}一大堆{/i}女生可能会杀了我。

lines.en: : Speaking of which, I still haven’t told you about Ami. And why you probably don’t want her memories carrying over.
lines.zh: : 说到这个，我还没告诉你 Ami 的事。以及为什么你大概不希望她的记忆延续下去。

lines.en: scene himaayanebeach7
: You’re not going to tell me she’s a wish too, are you? Because that would probably make these last twenty-four hours the most depressingly consequential of my entire life.
lines.zh: : 你该不会要告诉我她也是个愿望造物吧？因为那大概会让这最后的二十四小时变成我一生中最令人沮丧、也最意义重大的二十四小时。

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure they already were before we even got to the Ami stuff. But no. She’s real.
lines.zh: : 我觉得在我们聊到 Ami 的事之前，它们就已经是了。不过不是。她是真的。

lines.en: : She’s {i}different{/i} though.
lines.zh: : 只是她{i}不一样{/i}。

lines.en: : Different...how?
lines.zh: : 不一样……怎么不一样？

lines.en: : Different because-
lines.zh: : 不一样是因为——

lines.en: : Because she knows.
lines.zh: : 因为她知道。

lines.en: scene himaayanebeach8
: Ayane?...
lines.zh: : Ayane？……

lines.en: : How did you even-
lines.zh: : 你到底是怎么——

lines.en: : I don’t know...
lines.zh: : 我不知道……

lines.en: : I passed out from crying too hard and I was here when I woke up...
lines.zh: : 我哭得太厉害晕过去了，等我醒过来就在这儿了……

lines.en: : My head hurts...My eyes hurt...I want to curl up into a ball and die...
lines.zh: : 我头疼……眼睛也疼……我想蜷成一团去死……

lines.en: : I miss Aomori...And I don’t know if I’m going to be okay this time...
lines.zh: : 我想念 Aomori……而且我不知道这一次我还能不能好起来……

lines.en: scene himaayanebeach9
: But maybe...
lines.zh: : 但也许……

lines.en: : For the next few hours...
lines.zh: : 在接下来的几个小时里……

lines.en: : I can pretend I am?...
lines.zh: : 我可以假装自己还行？……

lines.en: scene himaayanebeach10
: Y-You don’t have to pretend anything! It’s {i}my{/i} fault you’re upset in the first place! I took {i}everything{/i} from you in a single moment! Being upset just means that you-
lines.zh: : 你……你什么也不用假装！你难过本来就是{i}我的{/i}错！我在一瞬间把你的{i}一切{/i}都夺走了！难过只说明你——

lines.en: : Hima-chan...was I a good mother?
lines.zh: : Hima 酱……我是个好妈妈吗？

lines.en: scene himaayanebeach11
: What?...Of course you were. How can you even ask that?
lines.zh: : 什么？……你当然是。你怎么能问这种问题？

lines.en: : I’ve always wanted to be a mom...Like, {i}that{/i} was my dream. Having a family. Coming home to the same faces every day. Waking up to them in the morning.
lines.zh: : 我一直想当个妈妈……就像，{i}那{/i}是我的梦想。拥有一个家。每天回家都能看到同样的面孔。早上醒来时他们就在身边。

lines.en: : I had that once when I was little. It felt like the whole world was confined to things that happened in my house. And that everything else was just noise.
lines.zh: : 我小时候曾经拥有过。感觉整个世界都被限制在我家里发生的事里。而其它一切都只是噪音。

lines.en: scene himaayanebeach12
: But one day, it all went away. And all I had {i}left{/i} was noise.
lines.zh: : 但有一天，一切都没了。而我{i}剩下的{/i}只有噪音。

lines.en: : The house was quiet when I woke up. There was no conversation when I’d go to the kitchen because there was no one home but me.
lines.zh: : 我醒来时屋子很安静。去厨房时也没有说话声，因为家里除了我就没别人。

lines.en: : I never realized just how loud everything can be when there’s nothing there to distract you.
lines.zh: : 我从来没意识到，当没有任何东西可以分散你注意力的时候，一切可以有多吵。

lines.en: : The water in the pipes...the hum of the air conditioner in summer...
lines.zh: : 水管里的水声……夏天空调的嗡嗡声……

lines.en: : The wind chime my mother bought that I {i}used{/i} to love before its sound became a plague on my ears that did nothing but remind me she was gone.
lines.zh: : 还有我妈妈买的风铃——我{i}以前{/i}很爱它的声音，直到那声音变成了折磨我耳朵的瘟疫，只会一遍遍提醒我她已经不在了。

lines.en: : I even grew to despise the sound of the birds because I needed to be mad at {i}something{/i} and there was just nothing else to be mad {i}at.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我甚至开始憎恨鸟叫声，因为我需要找点{i}东西{/i}生气，而除此之外根本没别的东西可以生气的。

lines.en: scene himaayanebeach13
: I always told myself I would never let something like that happen. That {i}my{/i} children would never have to feel alone and would never wake up to an empty home like I did.
lines.zh: : 我总是对自己说，我绝不会让这种事发生。{i}我的{/i}孩子永远不必感到孤独，永远不会像我一样在空荡荡的家里醒来。

lines.en: : That I would {i}always{/i} be there for them no matter how bad things got. And that they’d be able to count on me even if it felt like they couldn’t.
lines.zh: : 无论事情变得多糟，我都会{i}一直{/i}陪在他们身边。就算他们觉得不能指望我，他们也能指望我。

lines.en: : I have never been more hurt than I am right now. I feel like a piece of me has been ripped out and torn to shreds. That my lungs are full of fire and my heart is collapsing.
lines.zh: : 我这辈子从来没有比现在更受伤过。我感觉自己的一部分被撕下来、扯成了碎片。我的肺里全是火，我的心脏在塌陷。

lines.en: : But even if it was you who made me feel that way, it’s you who lets me feel at all.
lines.zh: : 但哪怕是让我有这种感觉的人是你，也是你让我还能感觉到任何东西。

lines.en: : Mom-
lines.zh: : 妈妈——

lines.en: : I won’t let you hate the birds as well.
lines.zh: : 我不会让你连鸟都恨上的。

lines.en: : You are still Hima-chan...and I am still your mother.
lines.zh: : 你还是 Hima 酱……而我还是你的母亲。

lines.en: : I am sorry I made you feel alone.
lines.zh: : 我很抱歉让你感到了孤独。

lines.en: scene himaayanebeach14
: No, it’s...
lines.zh: : 不，那是……

lines.en: : I haven’t felt {i}alone.{/i} Dad’s been with me. And I...fully expected you to hurt like this, so...if anything, you should be scolding me for intentionally putting you through that.
lines.zh: : 我没有感到{i}孤独{/i}。爸爸一直陪着我。而且我……早就预料到你会这样痛苦，所以……要说的话，你该骂我才对，是我故意让你承受这些的。

lines.en: : {i}I’m{/i} the one who should be apologizing. Not you.
lines.zh: : 该道歉的是{i}我{/i}。不是你。

lines.en: : You never have to apologize to me, Hima-chan.
lines.zh: : 你永远不必跟我道歉，Hima 酱。

lines.en: scene himaayanebeach15
: No, there should definitely be a clause in there that allows me to apologize if I dimension-jump into whatever world you’re in and vaporize myself in the genkan. I think that warrants it.
lines.zh: : 不，那里面绝对该有一条条款，允许我在次元跳跃到你在的世界、然后在玄关把自己蒸发掉的情况下道歉。我觉得这种情况适用。

lines.en: : I still don’t really understand, but...I’ll trust you if that’s what you need me to do. But know that I am incredibly broken right now and terrified that the life of my dreams is just that.
lines.zh: : 我还是不太明白，但……如果那是你需要我做的，我信你。不过要知道，我现在已经支离破碎，而且害怕我梦寐以求的人生就只是一场梦。

lines.en: : So I apologize if I’m not as strong as I was in Aomori. Assuming you...even know how strong that was in the first place.
lines.zh: : 所以如果我表现得没有在 Aomori 时那么坚强，我先道个歉。前提是……你一开始就知道那时候的我有多坚强。

lines.en: scene himaayanebeach16
: I remember everything...
lines.zh: : 我全都记得……

lines.en: : You...do? But how? You-
lines.zh: : 你……记得？可怎么办到的？你——

lines.en: : It’s long and complicated, but there’s an analogy involving solar panels Dad can clue you in on once we’re through here. In the meantime, we-
lines.zh: : 说来话长又复杂，不过有个关于太阳能板的比喻，等我们忙完这儿的事，爸爸可以给你解释。在那之前，我们——

lines.en: : Did it hurt?...
: Can I at least finish my spiel before I get into the specifics of how painful it is to vaporize an alternate version of myself?
lines.zh: : 在我细说蒸发掉另一个版本的自己有多痛之前，能让我先把话说完吗？

lines.en: : Sorry...what are we doing exactly? I’m still groggy and extremely nauseous, so I’m only 75%% present, but...you were talking about Ami, right?
lines.zh: : 抱歉……我们具体在做什么来着？我还晕着，而且恶心得要命，所以只有 75%% 在线，不过……你们刚才在聊 Ami，对吧？

lines.en: scene himaayanebeach17
: Right!
lines.zh: : 没错！

lines.en: scene himaayanebeach18
: Ayane, first and foremost, welcome back.
lines.zh: : Ayane，首先，欢迎回来。

lines.en: : Thank you for keeping her company while I was dying...I hope you two had fun together.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你在我快要死掉的时候陪着她……希望你们俩玩得开心。

lines.en: : Yeah, we’ve done a lot more than just have fun. Himawari has magical hand-powers that let her rearrange people’s memories, so we’ve been scouring the beach in search of all the girls.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我们做的可不只是玩得开心。Himawari 有能重新排列别人记忆的魔法手部能力，所以我们一直在海滩上搜寻所有女生。

lines.en: scene himaayanebeach19
: So, needless to say, it {i}has{/i} been pretty fun.
lines.zh: : 所以，不用说，{i}还是{/i}挺开心的。

lines.en: : We’re still looking for Ami and a few of the other girls, though. So if you know something about her being involved, now is the time to say it.
lines.zh: : 不过我们还在找 Ami 和其他几个女生。所以如果你知道一些关于她被卷入的事，现在是时候说了。

lines.en: : And I know the answer to this, so I am going to grade you harshly on your accuracy.
lines.zh: : 而我知道答案，所以我会给你的准确度打分打得很严。

lines.en: scene himaayanebeach20
: I mean...I can’t say anything for sure, but...I’ve had some suspicions about her for a while. And the way she’s been acting with Maya lately, just...
lines.zh: : 我是说……我不能肯定什么，但……我对她已经怀疑有一阵子了。还有她最近跟 Maya 相处的方式，就……

lines.en: : I feel like she knows more than she’s letting on. And that maybe she’s just pretending to be oblivious for...Ami reasons. I can’t think like a crazy person, so I can’t exactly pinpoint her motives.
lines.zh: : 我觉得她知道的比表现出来的多。而且也许她只是为了……Ami 的理由在装傻。我没法像疯子那样思考，所以我也没法准确指出她的动机。

lines.en: : And I {i}could{/i} be completely wrong about this. So if Hima-chan knows something, she’s much better off than I am trying to explain any of this.
lines.zh: : 而且我{i}可能{/i}完全错了。所以如果 Hima 酱知道什么，让她来解释这些可比我强多了。

lines.en: : Good work, Mom. And while nothing you said was really {i}inaccurate,{/i} you were still super vague about it, so I’m going to have to give you a B.
lines.zh: : 干得好，妈妈。虽然你说的基本{i}没错{/i}，但还是太含糊了，所以我只能给你打个 B。

lines.en: scene himaayanebeach21

: {size=-4}Now that the cat’s out of the bag and I managed to skirt violating one more company policy by not being the one to reveal it, I’m going to go ahead and break a {i}different{/i} policy by confirming that everything Mom said is true.{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-4}既然秘密已经说破，而且我又靠不是自己说出来的方式避开了再违反一条公司规定，那我就继续违反{i}另一条{/i}规定，确认妈妈说的全是真的。{/size}

lines.en: : Ami {i}does{/i} know that time is repeating itself. And she’s concealing it from you for what I can only imagine is the same thing I said earlier. She doesn’t want to leave.
lines.zh: : Ami {i}确实{/i}知道时间在重复。而且她对你隐瞒了这一点，原因我想只能是我之前说的那个——她不想离开。

lines.en: : Not being able to find her right now is par for the course too. That’s what I meant when I said she was troublesome. She {i}always{/i} does this because she always knows when it’s coming.
lines.zh: : 现在找不到她也是意料之中的事。这就是我说的她麻烦的意思。她{i}每次都{/i}这样，因为她每次都知道它要来了。

lines.en: : And even if we {i}were{/i} to get ahold of her, anything we’d do to her to affect her memories would only be temporary.
lines.zh: : 而且就算我们{i}能{/i}抓住她，我们对她的记忆做任何处理也都只是暂时的。

lines.en: : Why even bother then? If they’re just going to come back?
lines.zh: : 那干嘛还费这个劲？反正它们都会回来的？

lines.en: scene himaayanebeach22
: Testing mostly. She’s one more thing that doesn’t make sense in what is essentially an entire world full of inconsistencies.
lines.zh: : 主要是做测试。在一个基本上满是矛盾的整个世界里，她是又一个说不通的东西。

lines.en: : We’ve figured out why {i}Maya’s{/i} special, but Ami is a paradox of her own. And what {i}really{/i} sucks for us is that she seems to be aware of it.
lines.zh: : 我们已经搞清楚 {i}Maya{/i} 为什么特殊，但 Ami 是她自己的一个悖论。而对我们来说{i}真正{/i}糟心的是，她似乎对此有自觉。

lines.en: : So every time we find her, we try something new. And, once {i}that{/i} doesn’t work, it’s back to the drawing board and time to wait for another chrono-intermission.
lines.zh: : 所以每次我们找到她，我们就试个新办法。而一旦{i}那{/i}不管用，就推倒重来，等下一次时间幕间休息。

lines.en: : What do you mean you {i}try something new?...{/i}
lines.zh: : 你说{i}试个新办法{/i}是什么意思？……

lines.en: scene himaayanebeach23
: What do you {i}do{/i} to her?...
lines.zh: : 你们对她{i}做{/i}什么？……

lines.en: : Me personally? Nada. A girl like Ami is {i}way{/i} above my pay-grade. Nor am I confident that there’s anything that can really be {i}done{/i} with her in the first place.
lines.zh: : 我本人？什么也不做。像 Ami 这样的女孩{i}远超{/i}我的权限等级。而且我本来也不确信对她真能有什么{i}办法{/i}。

lines.en: : We have to try, though. And I’m desperate enough to try {i}anything{/i} at this point. So if she has some sort of answer, even if it’s a small one, I need it. It might help me save you.
lines.zh: : 不过我们必须试。而我现在已经绝望到{i}什么都{/i}愿意试了。所以如果她有什么答案，哪怕是很小的答案，我都需要它。它可能帮我救你。

lines.en: : You don’t, like...{i}hurt{/i} her...do you? Because I love you, but there’s no way I’m going to help you look for Ami if you’re going to try and torture answers out of her or something.
lines.zh: : 你们应该不会……{i}伤害{/i}她吧？因为我爱你，但如果你打算严刑逼供什么的，我绝对不会帮你去找 Ami。

lines.en: scene himaayanebeach24
: I wouldn’t want to torture her either. I told you earlier — I {i}like{/i} Ami.
lines.zh: : 我也不想折磨她。我早跟你说过——我{i}喜欢{/i} Ami。

lines.en: : Besides, do I really look like the torturing type? I can’t even squish bugs. I have to put them in a cup and bring them outside because I’m worried they might have bug families.
lines.zh: : 再说，我真长得像会刑讯逼供的人吗？我连虫子都不敢捏死。我得把它们装进杯子里拿到外面去，因为我担心它们可能也有虫子家庭。

lines.en: : Or even worse — a bug daughter who travels through bug-time in an endless bug-effort to reunite said bug family. I don’t want to squish {i}myself,{/i} Dad. Under...most circumstances.
lines.zh: : 或者更糟——一个穿越虫子时间、为了和虫子家庭团聚而无休止努力的虫子女儿。我可不想把{i}自己{/i}捏死，爸爸。在……大多数情况下。

lines.en: : So, if we find her, then what? Because she won’t come easily if she’s avoiding you like this.
lines.zh: : 那么，如果我们找到她，然后呢？既然她这么躲着你，她不会轻易就范的。

lines.en: : I ask her peacefully and passively if she will divulge all of the information she possesses to me. Then I touch her head and give her a quick little temporary memory buzz.
lines.zh: : 我会平和地、被动地问她，愿不愿意把她掌握的所有信息都告诉我。然后我摸摸她的头，给她来一次小小的临时记忆冲击。

lines.en: : And when she won’t tell you anything?
lines.zh: : 而如果她什么也不告诉你呢？

lines.en: scene himaayanebeach25
: I call Shi-chan and let {i}her{/i} take care of it.
lines.zh: : 我就叫 {i}Shi 酱{/i}来处理。

lines.en: : Shi...chan?
lines.zh: : Shi……酱？

lines.en: : My cool senpai who smokes cigarettes and refuses to tell me anything about the dark past she’s incessantly haunted by.
lines.zh: : 我那位很酷的前辈，抽烟，而且绝口不提那段一直缠着她的黑暗过往。

lines.en: scene himaayanebeach26
: Aww...you have a friend.
lines.zh: : 哇哦……你有朋友了。

lines.en: : Can I meet her? You never brought anyone home in Aomori. I want to make sure she’s a good influence. Which she probably isn’t since she smokes, but still.
lines.zh: : 我能见见她吗？你在 Aomori 的时候从没带过谁回家。我想确认她是不是个好的影响。她抽烟，八成不是，但还是想见。

lines.en: : I was actually just about to call her and ask how-
lines.zh: : 我正要打电话问她——

lines.en: scene himaayanebeach27
: Ah! That’s probably her now.
lines.zh: : 啊！大概就是她打来了。
